== Unique Spears ==
<noinclude>
All non-class spears now gain bonus damage equal to 75% strength & 75% dexterity instead of 100% strength.

In addition to the changes listed here, all melee weapons also gain <span class="nmod">Melee Attacks Deal Splash Damage</span>.

Ethereal weapons gain a x1.25 damage bonus instead of a x1.5 damage bonus.

See [[Class_Weapons#Spears|Class Weapons]] for unique Amazon Spears. Also see [[Throwing#Elite_Javelins|Throwing Spears (Javelins)]].
</noinclude>
